question: Can other hues be effectively used in plaster works according to this teaching?
premises: Other hues are described as capable.
This capability applies in plaster works.
inference: Other hues may also be suitable for use in plaster works.
uncertainties: su+vrataḥ may be a vocative address or an epithet; its role is slightly ambiguous.
plain_english: O well-vowed one, other hues may be capable in plaster works.
